summary: CourseDocument manages course-related documents, including metadata, file operations, and database records. It represents individual documents and collections, facilitates CRUD operations, and ensures accurate presentation and validation of document information.
purpose: To store, retrieve, validate, display, and manage course documents and their metadata in the system. It supports adding, deleting, searching, and formatting information for presentation and integration.

workflows.name: Add Course Document
steps: If valid, set DB procedure: CourseDocumentAddDoc.
Add parameters: SessionID, CourseDocumentID, CourseID, TypeCodeID, DocumentName, TypeComments, FileURL, FilePath, FileSize, FileType.
Execute DB query to insert the document.

workflows.name: Delete Course Document
steps: Delete file and containing folder (ignore exceptions).
Delete database record using CourseDocumentDelete procedure.

workflows.name: Load Course Documents by Course ID
steps: FillList populates CourseDocument instances with retrieved data.

workflows.name: Load Course Document by ID
steps: FillList populates CourseDocument instances with retrieved data.

business_rules: TypeCodeID must not be 0 to add a document.
If code is 'OTHER', TypeCode is set to localized 'Other'.
Use alt-language TypeCode if alt language mode is enabled.
DocumentName is preferred as link text; if absent, use TypeCode.
If FileURL is present and file exists, render it as a hyperlink.
validations: TypeCodeID must not be zero when adding a document.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted concatenates parts of AgencyShortName and user's name initials.
FileSize is divided by 1000 for display as kilobytes.
UpdateDateFormatted is derived using date formatting utility.
conditions: If sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true, use TypeCodeAlt.
If FileURL is not empty and file exists, display as hyperlink.
If FileURL is not empty and file does not exist, display 'Document_Not_Found'.
If Email is empty, EmailFormatted is string.Empty.
system_behavior: Silent exception handling during file/folder deletion.
Presentation formatting for names, dates, and emails.
dependencies: Resources for localization strings (Other, Document_Not_Found, etc.)
UI.NameFormatter and UI.DateFormatter for display formatting
System.IO for file and directory manipulation
exceptions: File and directory deletion ignore exceptions.
Validation failures block document addition and add error message.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling for DB failures.
UI and localization implementations not shown.
Details about Phone class not included.
